preconditions.description: N is the number of tasks and M is the number of dependencies.

preconditions.expression: all(E[i] in {0, 1} for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each task can only be executed on the main processor (0) or the coprocessor (1).

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= T1 < N and 0 <= T2 < N and T1 != T2 for T1, T2 in dependencies)
preconditions.description: Each dependency is a pair of distinct tasks within the valid range.

postconditions.description: The output is the minimal number of coprocessor calls necessary to execute the program.
